A 13-acre Godrej township on NH-44 in Rajendra Nagar — 2, 3 & 4 BHK homes in Luxe and Premium formats, the palace-themed Club Regalia and 75,000 sq.ft of curated landscapes.

  • Palace-themed Club Regalia clubhouse
  • 75,000 sq.ft of curated landscapes incl. Regal Meadow
  • Atrium, Chamber, Arcade and Pavilion amenity levels
  • 80% open-space layout on 13 acres

Questions about Regal Pavilion

What is the price of Regal Pavilion by Godrej Properties?

Regal Pavilion starts at ₹1.10 Cr onwards (indicative, compiled from public listings as of July 2026). 2–4 BHK · saleable ~1,352–3,571 sq.ft. Floor-rise, parking, GST and other charges are extra — Livarea shares the official cost sheet on request.

What configurations and sizes are available at Regal Pavilion?

2 BHK Luxe: 1,352 sq.ft saleable · 865 sq.ft RERA carpet; 3 BHK Premium: 1,680 sq.ft saleable · 1,050 sq.ft RERA carpet; 3 BHK (larger formats): 2,017 – 2,674 sq.ft saleable; 4 BHK Premium: 2,904 sq.ft saleable; 4 BHK Luxe: 3,571 sq.ft saleable.

Is Regal Pavilion RERA registered?

Ask Livarea for the current RERA registration details of Regal Pavilion, and always verify the number on rera.telangana.gov.in before paying any booking amount.

Where is Regal Pavilion located?

Regal Pavilion is in Rajendra Nagar, Hyderabad. The Purple Line extension and airport-corridor expressway access are opening this belt to institutional-grade launches. Prices in the Rajendra Nagar corridor are roughly ₹6,000–9,000/sqft.

What are the key features of Regal Pavilion?

Palace-themed Club Regalia clubhouse; 75,000 sq.ft of curated landscapes incl. Regal Meadow; Atrium, Chamber, Arcade and Pavilion amenity levels; 80% open-space layout on 13 acres.

How can I get the Regal Pavilion brochure?
